Lotus London is a leading provider of top quality and highly regarded mobile massage.

Here at Lotus London, we fully understand how busy and stressful modern day life can sometimes be. We also understand that as someone living in a large city, you often simply do not have the time to visit your massage therapist on a regular basis. It is for this reason that our team has decided to do things a little differently in that we offer our clients mobile massage treatments, thereby eliminating you having to battle the traffic and the busy streets of London to make your massage appointment because we come to wherever you are!

Whether you require a massage due to a sports injury, to combat fatigue after a stressful event, or you simply find that our deep tissue massages are a great help for relaxation, our team of highly qualified massage therapists will gladly assist you. Our massages can help to relieve pain and also assist you in rebalancing your energy and help you to sleep better.
